scope: Exact-recipient owner-state unread count without page-derived totals or foreign policy calls

canonical_plan_sync.follow_up: Synchronize the canonical plan without replacing unrelated concurrent task updates

policy.ownership_scope: exact non-nil tenant and recipient identities supplied by an authorized caller
policy.selection: count only notification rows whose owner state equals unread
policy.query_order: apply tenant then recipient then unread-state filters before counting
policy.empty_foreign_result: empty missing cross-tenant and cross-recipient scopes all return unread_count zero
policy.count_authority: the notifications owner table is authoritative; callers must not derive totals from authorized list pages
policy.privacy_reconciliation: the count reflects stored owner state; current privacy and source changes enter it only after exact or scheduled reconciliation archives unavailable rows
policy.index_support: reuse idx_notifications_inbox on tenant recipient state created_at and id
policy.foreign_calls: counting calls no recipient privacy source provider target or delivery owner
policy.mutation_boundary: counting mutates no notification state timestamp reconciliation or delivery attempt
policy.response: return only unread_count without notification source target or cursor identity
policy.transport_boundary: no HTTP GraphQL native server function or UI adapter is delivered

not_delivered: tenant-wide scheduled reconciliation and payload redaction
external inbox transport and UI adapters
search index SEO and deep-link migration
